name: The Old Smoke
author: takedadesmullier
description:
The Old Smoke: More than a game... it’s an universe.
Have you had this experience before? You arrive at a place you had visited years before and realise that it has changed. Buildings have disappeared, replaced by others, holes have been plugged in the road, an old telephone box has been removed. You then tell yourself that these are works carried out by the city. This is undoubtedly the case. But this is not necessarily the reality. There are a lot of strange things in this world that we don't know about. And world eaters are one of them.
These creatures come to our world at night with only one goal: to feed themselves. They feed on matter and it is not uncommon for them to devour entire buildings, so great is their hunger. So every night, holes appear in our cities and every day we try to fill them. This is why our neighbourhoods evolve and change their appearance.
World-eaters are intelligent beings. Like humans, they have learned how to store food. What disappears is not eating right away... but sending it to a pantry. An unusual pantry in another dimension: the K-dimension. There they can gradually liquefy the material to better digest it.
Since 2063, the Franco-British company Legspace has been exploring dimensions that were unknown to us. Its main objective: to find new materials whose exploitation could allow the development of new technologies. In particular, Legspace is looking for D-F45 or Blue Fagaril, a liquid charged with a temporal energy that could enable humanity to travel through time.
Was there any in the K-dimension, no one knew. That's why, after four years of testing, Legspace finally sent a reconnaissance mission in this dimension. The first expedition was disastrous. The crew mysteriously disappeared. It turned out, after several analyses, that this dimension was particularly hostile. The world-eaters that live there can be aggressive, and the liquefied matter, which has been named K-liquid, is toxic.
